Common Data For 8 and 9 : 
Ten telemetry signals, each of bandwidth 2 kHz, are to be 
transmitted simultaneously by binary PCM. The maximum 
tolerable error in sample amplitudes is 0.2% of the peak 
signal amplitude. The signals must be sampled at least 20% 
above the Nyquist rate. Framing and synchronizing 
requires an additional 1% extra bits.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-05 (ECE/IN).
